zones.title: Dealers
zones.body: Rows from ar_mock_dealers, narrowed by market, dealerId and city (accent-insensitive).

zones.title: Reservation
zones.body: POST reservations: vehicle plus dealer give a reservation id that carries the dealer; a dealer without online booking answers dealer_not_dealerbook_enabled.

zones.title: Services and fulfilments
zones.body: GET services and GET fulfilments of a reservation (POST on the lab): the catalogues, 404 for an unknown reservation id.

zones.title: Patch
zones.body: PATCH reservations: the selected services, fulfilment or timeslot. Acknowledged with what was patched, not stored; 404 for an unknown reservation id.

zones.title: Timeslots
zones.body: GET timeslots in fromDateTime..toDateTime; dealer from the reservation id or the request; deterministic from dealerId and date so tests repeat (the one Code node kept in the mocks).

zones.title: Book
zones.body: POST bookings: required fields, then the FULL probe (409), then the DealerBook booking id and the six-letter reference code hashed from the idempotency key. Bookings persist in ar_mock_bookings.

zones.title: Bookings lookup
zones.body: GET bookings by customerId, chassisNumber, offerId or status (POST on the lab); a referenceCode narrows to the spoken code.

zones.title: Cancel
zones.body: POST bookings/{bookingId}: marks the booking cancelled.

zones.title: Reschedule
zones.body: POST bookings/{bookingId}/reschedule: the booking keeps its id and reference code and gets the new timeslot; movedFrom records the old one.

panels.title: Mock DealerBook
panels.body: Endpoints under ar-mock/dealerbook/* follow the API V2 lifecycle of the endpoint sheet (2026-10-23): a reservation (vehicle and dealer), its services and fulfilments, a PATCH per selection, timeslots in a window, then the booking. The reservation id carries the dealer so the mock stays stateless; a PATCH is acknowledged, not stored. A slotId containing FULL returns 409. Lookup keys are customerId, chassisNumber, offerId and status; a booking has a DealerBook booking id and a six-letter reference code. Bookings persist in ar_mock_bookings. Payload shapes are the mock's own until question 23 is answered.
